verdict.rationale: AssemblyAI's model docs list keyterms prompting of up to 1,000 words plus contextual prompting, a first-party way to bias transcription toward domain terms, names, and jargon. Community users independently describe customizing it to a medical vocabulary and to 'terms of art', though one critic doubts that adding new words works as flawlessly as claimed; that is skepticism, not a documented failure. missing for 10: in-depth docs on the keyterms parameter (API usage, whether it works for streaming as well as pre-recorded audio, boosting behavior), current hands-on accuracy evidence for boosted terms.
